remarks: High-end renovations just completed in this 2 bed, 2 bath apartment with city views, and all utilities included in the rent! Enjoy brand new flooring in every room, sleek quartz countertops with bar seating in the kitchen, and generous entertainment space with light pouring in from the oversized window in the living room. Two assigned covered parking spots, 24-hr concierge service, and complimentary access to the building gym and sauna. Unbeatable location with public transportation at your doorstep; just minutes to downtown Stamford's restaurants, shopping, and entertainment.
